snippet.title: New feature tonight: multiple hotbars you can swap mid-fight #actionrpg #indiedev #shorts
snippet.description:
Latest feature in my solo-dev ARPG, Zukarii: multiple swappable hotbars. 

You start with one, and + currently lets you add up to two more (each with all 8 slots, L/R included) — cycle through them with Tab or the arrows, and a Roman numeral shows which one’s active. 

Small UI feature, but it already opens up a lot more build variety without everything getting crammed onto one bar. Coming Soon: Weapon swap with default hotbar per weapon set!

 Still very early — pre-alpha, placeholder art and all — just documenting the build as it comes together.
